profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded as STX, with headquarters listed in Singapore. Its website describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says the company has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. Seagate says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as a driver of data growth and a reshaping force on storage requirements. Seagate says it is optimizing storage for AI and making gains in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout, and it points readers toward assessing their organization's readiness and developing a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth. It also states that people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing large volumes of data.

The company's profile lists it as a for-profit public company with the ticker STX and a CIK of 0001137789. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
